## Problem

Describe the problem and link its issue with a closing keyword when applicable.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and any deliberate limits.

## Validation

List commands, results, and any checks that could not run.

## Specification

Link the added or modified OpenSpec spec.md when changing src/ or test/. Otherwise, explain why this
small management, harness, documentation, or dependency change needs no specification. For a
template behavior change, keep this PR draft until the approved package is implemented. After
validation, request human acceptance; archive only when explicitly instructed. Split PRs may carry
active changes into feature branches; the final PR into main must archive them. Approval labels
assist review and are not required checks.
